slides.title: Home, Sweet Home
bullets: Prepare to read, discuss and write
slides.narration: Welcome to Grade 2 English, Unit 8: Home, Sweet Home. This unit is all about homes. You will learn the names of homes for people and for animals — a house, a flat, a hut, a tree house, a nest, a hive and a hole. You will name the rooms inside a home and the things we keep in them, and you will compare homes from around the world. You will say where things are with in, on, under, next to, between and above, use there is and there are to say what a home has, and use will to promise the jobs you will do at home. By the end you can give a tour of your own home, just like Amal does in this unit's story, “Helping Hands at Home”. In this short lecture, preview the key ideas and prepare for the independent lesson.

slides.title: What you will achieve
bullets: Name different kinds of homes for people and animals.
Name the rooms in a home and say what people do in each one.
Name common things at home and say which room they belong in.
slides.narration: By the end of this unit, you will be able to name different kinds of homes for people and animals. You will also name the rooms in a home and say what people do in each one. You will also name common things at home and say which room they belong in. Keep these goals in mind as you work.

slides.title: Words to learn
slides.narration: Your vocabulary work begins with these words: name, game, late, place, theme, bathroom. Listen to each word, look at what it means, and try to use it when you talk and write.

slides.title: Read and think
bullets: Point to the words that show it
slides.narration: The reading sequence includes A Poem: “Homes” and Different Kinds of Homes. Read slowly, look at the pictures, and find the big idea in each text. When you answer a question, point to the words that show it.

slides.title: Prepositions of Place
bullets: Prepositions of place are small words that tell us where something is. They help you describe your home so that another person can picture every room.
Try it in your own sentences
slides.narration: The first language focus is Prepositions of Place. Prepositions of place are small words that tell us where something is. They help you describe your home so that another person can picture every room. Look at the examples, then try the pattern in your own sentences.

slides.title: Use English for a real purpose
bullets: Speaking 1 — Describe a Kind of Home
Writing 1 — A Paragraph About Your Home
Say it, write it, make it better
slides.narration: In speaking, you will complete Speaking 1 — Describe a Kind of Home. Say your ideas clearly and listen to your partner. In writing, you will draw, trace, copy or write, then check your work with a grown-up or the AI tutor.

slides.title: You are ready to begin
bullets: Activities, quiz and optional live sessions
slides.narration: You are ready to begin. Start with the words, then the reading and the questions, then the grammar, speaking and writing. Ask the AI tutor for help any time, and bring your questions to a live session too if you join one.
